title: Watching a swimmer from an exercise bike led Sola Alegbe from a lifelong fear of water to teaching it

posts.facebook:
Sola Alegbe nearly drowned at school and feared water for 30 years. She took her first lesson at 48. Now she teaches swimming.

How a Londoner who nearly drowned as a child learned to swim at 48, left her job at Transport for London and qualified as a swimming teacher. What the first lesson is really like, and how to start if water frightens you, or go further if you already swim.

The first step does not have to be a jump: holding the rail and blowing bubbles counts.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/move/sola-alegbe-swimming-teacher/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
